listing.name: Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: PlayStation port prepared with your own matching disc and any required BIOS. Complete setup with the project’s launcher; you manage this copy, its updates and your saved data.

steps.title: Download and unpack the setup kit
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official ZIP for your system into a separate writable folder. On Linux use your native C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja and Python 3. The packaged setup host needs glibc 2.29, GLIBCXX 3.4.26, OpenGL and zlib. On macOS 11 or later, choose the Intel or Apple Silicon archive and put the Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH.

steps.title: Supply the matching originals in order
steps.instruction: Use your own European two-disc set SLES-02801 then SLES-12801. Keep each disc image and every referenced track together. Use your supported European retail SCPH-5552 BIOS for the player. The included OpenBIOS is a setup fallback. Follow the bundled setup guide for the image formats and BIOS selection.

steps.title: Build and add the completed player
steps.instruction: Run the Alone_in_the_Dark__The_New_Nightmare setup host (with .exe on Windows), then use its Generate & rebuild wizard. Add the completed player from build-release with that folder as its start folder. Keep the whole creating folder and its runtime companions.

warnings: Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay for this package.
The guide covers upstream-owned setup and replacement. Preserve all discs, saves, settings and overlay captures. Disc changes during gameplay remain unobserved.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep a working copy and its data before changing versions. Use the project’s tools for updates and back up your original files, saves and settings yourself.
